findings: The reader sees the full source-clause inventory and now explicitly passes the selected policy clauses, original act clauses and role index to the typed authority child.
The child contains a genuine numbered natural-language candidate, authentication, scope and uncertainty procedure; no case-specific crisp policy is substituted.
The child result's authority, scope and reason are consumed by the reader, with clause-keyed quotation and original witness binding.
A decisive established attribution or agreement across every still-supported attribution is required for true; a nonempty supported candidate set is required for false.
Authenticated source role or form may establish authority without an invented personally named issuer; this is necessary for the original signed instructions S01 and S02.
